# BetterHermosa

> Community-powered portal of the Municipality of Hermosa, Bataan. Volunteer-run and open source; part of the BetterGov.ph network. Not an official government website — the official site is https://www.hermosa.gov.ph.

## Key pages

- [BetterHermosa | Hermosa, Bataan Officials & Services](https://betterhermosa.org/)
- [Hermosa, Bataan Mayor, Vice Mayor & Councilors | BetterHermosa](https://betterhermosa.org/government/elected-officials)
- [Municipal Offices & Departments of Hermosa, Bataan | BetterHermosa](https://betterhermosa.org/government/departments)
- [Barangays of Hermosa, Bataan — Directory | BetterHermosa](https://betterhermosa.org/government/barangays)
- [Municipal Services in Hermosa, Bataan — Requirements & Steps | BetterHermosa](https://betterhermosa.org/services)
- [About BetterHermosa | Community Portal for Hermosa, Bataan](https://betterhermosa.org/about)
- [Contact BetterHermosa | Hermosa, Bataan](https://betterhermosa.org/contact)
- [Weather in Hermosa, Bataan Today | BetterHermosa](https://betterhermosa.org/data/weather)
- [Contribute to BetterHermosa | Hermosa, Bataan](https://betterhermosa.org/contribute)
- [Accessibility Statement | BetterHermosa](https://betterhermosa.org/accessibility)
- [Sitemap | BetterHermosa](https://betterhermosa.org/sitemap)
